articles.title: What the teams said – Race day in Miami
articles.summary: What the teams said – Race day in Miami. The drivers and teams report back on all the action from the Grand Prix at the Miami International Autodrome.

articles.title: All the key moments from the 2026 Miami Grand Prix
articles.summary: All the key moments from the 2026 Miami Grand Prix. It was another successful weekend for Kimi Antonelli at the Miami International Autodrome, with the Mercedes driver claiming his third successive Grand Prix pole position and victory to extend his championship lead over team mate George Russell.

articles.title: Verstappen hit with penalty for pit exit breach during Miami GP
articles.summary: Verstappen hit with penalty for pit exit breach during Miami GP. A five-second time penalty has gone Max Verstappen’s way for crossing the white line at the pit exit in the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Leclerc penalised by Miami Grand Prix stewards
articles.summary: Leclerc penalised by Miami Grand Prix stewards. Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc has been hit with a penalty following the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Verstappen admits regret over strategy call in Miami
articles.summary: Verstappen admits regret over strategy call in Miami. Max Verstappen beat Charles Leclerc over the line to P5 in a dramatic conclusion to the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Gasly and Lawson explain their Miami GP collision
articles.summary: Gasly and Lawson explain their Miami GP collision. Pierre Gasly was flipped upside down following contact with Liam Lawson in the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Watch the highlights from Miami as Antonelli beats Norris
articles.summary: Watch the highlights from Miami as Antonelli beats Norris. Kimi Antonelli recovered from a chaotic opening lap to clinch his third Grand Prix win of the season in Miami.

articles.title: Leclerc admits final lap spin in Miami 'all on me'
articles.summary: Leclerc admits final lap spin in Miami 'all on me'. Charles Leclerc admits that his dramatic spin on the final lap of the Miami Grand Prix "is all on me" as the Ferrari driver lost out on a potential podium.

articles.title: ‘No excuses’ after missing out on Miami win – Norris
articles.summary: ‘No excuses’ after missing out on Miami win – Norris. Despite being "gutted" to miss out on a victory at the Miami Grand Prix, Lando Norris was also able to take the positives after claiming second place for McLaren.

articles.title: Antonelli overjoyed with record-breaking Miami win
articles.summary: Antonelli overjoyed with record-breaking Miami win. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli expressed his pride and satisfaction after a hard-fought run to victory in the Miami Grand Prix – becoming the first driver in F1 history to win his first three races from his first three pole positions.

articles.title: Hold the Antonelli hype for a race or two longer
articles.summary: Hold the Antonelli hype for a race or two longer. Kimi Antonelli is making history, but Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff thinks it's too early to talk about the 19-year-old's chances of winning his first championship.

articles.title: Verstappen jokes 360 was intentional after hectic Miami GP
articles.summary: Verstappen jokes 360 was intentional after hectic Miami GP. Max Verstappen joked “if F1 doesn’t work out, I can always go rallying” after spinning at the start of the Miami Grand Prix before recovering to fifth place.

articles.title: McLaren could have put up better fight for Miami GP win - Norris
articles.summary: McLaren could have put up better fight for Miami GP win - Norris. Lando Norris believes McLaren could have offered a stronger fight against Kimi Antonelli for victory in the Miami Grand Prix after being beaten on strategy.

articles.title: Leclerc hit with Miami post-race penalty for chaotic final lap
articles.summary: Leclerc hit with Miami post-race penalty for chaotic final lap. Charles Leclerc has been handed a 20-second time penalty following the Miami Grand Prix for leaving the track multiple times on the final lap of the race.

articles.title: Antonelli outduels Norris for Miami GP win
articles.summary: Antonelli outduels Norris for Miami GP win. Kimi Antonelli claimed his third successive victory after seeing off a challenge from Lando Norris in a Miami Grand Prix constantly under threat from rain that never arrived.

articles.title: Red Bull admits mistake as Hadjar’s car deemed illegal post-qualifying
articles.summary: Red Bull admits mistake as Hadjar’s car deemed illegal post-qualifying. Isack Hadjar has been excluded from the Miami GP qualifying results after his car’s floor boards were found to not comply with the technical regulations.

articles.title: As the F1 season resumes, drivers feel things are moving in the right direction
articles.summary: As the F1 season resumes, drivers feel things are moving in the right direction. Verstappen, Norris, Piastri and Leclerc expressed optimism about the state of the new regulations, though they hope more changes are to come.

articles.title: Miami GP start time moved up due to weather
articles.summary: Miami GP start time moved up due to weather. The Miami Grand Prix will start at 1:00pm ET –  three hours earlier than originally scheduled –  due to the threat of thunderstorms on Sunday.

articles.title: Antonelli admits he was 'pretty stressed' after final Q3 run risked Miami pole
articles.summary: Antonelli admits he was 'pretty stressed' after final Q3 run risked Miami pole. Kimi Antonelli admits he was worried either Max Verstappen or Charles Leclerc would beat him to pole position after an error on his final lap in Q3 at the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Antonelli storms to Miami GP pole
articles.summary: Antonelli storms to Miami GP pole. The championship leader controlled qualifying to claim his third consecutive pole position.

articles.title: Antonelli steps up his level in dramatic fashion
articles.summary: Antonelli steps up his level in dramatic fashion. Kimi Antonelli's first season in F1 showed occasional promise, but nothing that suggested this was going to come next, writes Andrew Benson.

articles.title: Antonelli 'stupendous' and Leclerc's 'lairy final lap' - driver ratings
articles.summary: Antonelli 'stupendous' and Leclerc's 'lairy final lap' - driver ratings. BBC Radio 5 Live F1 commentator Harry Benjamin rates how the drivers performed during the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: Antonelli wins in Miami to extend title lead
articles.summary: Antonelli wins in Miami to extend title lead. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli holds off Lando Norris in a race-long battle to win the Miami Grand Prix and take a commanding championship lead.

articles.title: Andrew Benson Q&A: Send us your questions
articles.summary: Andrew Benson Q&A: Send us your questions. Our F1 correspondent Andrew Benson is doing a weekly Q&A this season, so get your questions in now.

articles.title: Miami race brought forward because of storm threat
articles.summary: Miami race brought forward because of storm threat. Sunday's Miami Grand Prix is moved forward by three hours to 18:00 BST because of the threat of thunderstorms.

articles.title: Antonelli on Miami pole from revived Verstappen
articles.summary: Antonelli on Miami pole from revived Verstappen. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli bounces back from a difficult sprint race to take pole position for the Miami Grand Prix.

articles.title: F1: Chequered Flag
articles.summary: F1: Chequered Flag. Harry and the team look back at a busy Saturday in Miami

articles.title: Norris takes dominant win in Miami sprint race
articles.summary: Norris takes dominant win in Miami sprint race. Lando Norris takes McLaren's first victory of the 2026 season with a dominant drive from pole position in the Miami Grand Prix sprint race.

articles.title: The remarkable life of Zanardi, a 21st century hero who inspired millions
articles.summary: The remarkable life of Zanardi, a 21st century hero who inspired millions. Alex Zanardi was a 21st century hero - a man who inspired millions through his unquenchable spirit in the face of unbelievable adversity, writes Andrew Benson.

articles.title: The Scot helping drive forward a new Formula 1 team
articles.summary: The Scot helping drive forward a new Formula 1 team. Allan McNish knows more than most about motorsport's highs and lows as he starts a new role with Audi.
